fullPassage: While it is true that individual skills are the most important in the world of sports, having a partner who can cooperate with the player with those skills is equally important. In a marathon, a key reason a front runner can reach the finish line after that long journey is the presence of a pacemaker. The pacemaker helps maintain a steady pace for the front runner, shielding the front runner from the headwind. Without the pacemaker, the front runner has to cope with the harsh wind alone and put in extra effort to maintain the pace. In Formula One, the world's largest car race series, each team enters two cars. Both drivers try their best for victory, but for the team's win, one person employs strategies such as blocking or obstructing other vehicles so that their teammate can get ahead. In rock climbing, individual skills are essential, but when a mistake is made, the person referred to as the belay partner manages the rope to prevent a fall. Similarly, in the case of scuba diving, all divers are paired up with a dive companion called a "buddy." The buddies are responsible for each other's safety. No matter how exceptional your skills may be, you cannot do it alone.

questions.passage: While it is true that individual skills are the most important in the world of sports, ①<u>having</u> a partner who can cooperate with the player with those skills is equally important. In a marathon, a key reason a front runner can reach the finish line after that long journey is the ②<u>presence</u> of a pacemaker. The pacemaker helps ③<u>maintain</u> a steady pace for the front runner, shielding the front runner from the headwind. Without the pacemaker, the front runner has to cope with the harsh wind alone and put in extra effort ④<u>maintain</u> the pace.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④maintain → to maintain: 'effort to maintain' = 유지하기 위한 노력. to부정사(목적).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ maintain → to maintain: 'put in extra effort to maintain'이 원문. effort + to-V.
❌ ① having: 동명사 주어 적절.
❌ ② presence: 명사 적절.
❌ ③ maintain: helps + 동사원형 적절.
det.tip: effort + to-V = ~하기 위한 노력. helps + V(원형) = ~하는 것을 돕다.

questions.passage: In Formula One, the world's largest car race series, each team enters two cars. Both drivers try their best for victory, but for the team's win, one person ①<u>employs</u> strategies such as blocking or obstructing other vehicles so that their teammate can get ahead. In rock climbing, individual skills are ②<u>essential</u>, but when a mistake ③<u>is made</u>, the person referred to as the belay partner manages the rope to prevent a ④<u>falling</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④falling → fall: 'prevent a fall' = 추락을 방지하다. fall은 명사('추락').
det.analysis:
✅ ④ falling → fall: 'a fall'(명사: 추락)이 원문. prevent + 명사.
❌ ① employs: 3인칭 단수 현재 적절.
❌ ② essential: 보어 형용사 적절.
❌ ③ is made: 수동태(실수가 만들어지다) 적절.
det.tip: fall(명사: 추락, 동사: 떨어지다). prevent + 명사 = ~을 방지하다.

questions.passage: While it is true that individual skills are the most important in the world of sports, having a partner ①<u>who</u> can cooperate with the player with those skills is equally important. The pacemaker helps maintain a steady pace for the front runner, ②<u>shielding</u> the front runner from the headwind. In the case of scuba diving, all divers are paired up with a dive companion ③<u>calling</u> a "buddy." The buddies are ④<u>responsible</u> for each other's safety. No matter how exceptional your skills may be, you cannot do it alone.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③calling → called: companion이 '불리는' 것이므로 과거분사. 수동 관계.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ calling → called: 'a dive companion called a buddy'가 원문. companion은 '불려지는' 대상(수동).
❌ ① who: 선행사 partner(사람) → 주격 관계대명사.
❌ ② shielding: 분사구문(동시동작) 적절.
❌ ④ responsible: 'responsible for' = ~에 책임 있는.
det.tip: called(과거분사) = '~라고 불리는'. 수동: be called. calling(현재분사) = '~라고 부르는'(능동).

questions.passage: While it is true that individual skills are the most important in the world of sports, having a partner who can cooperate with the player with those skills is equally important. Without the pacemaker, the front runner has to ③<u>cope</u> with the harsh wind alone and put in extra ④<u>effort</u> to maintain the pace.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ②exposing(노출시키며) → shielding(보호하며): 페이스메이커는 선두 주자를 맞바람으로부터 '보호'하는 것이지 '노출'시키는 것이 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② exposing → shielding: 원문 'shielding the front runner from the headwind'.
❌ ① steady(일정한): 'a steady pace' 적절.
❌ ③ cope(대처하다): 'cope with the harsh wind' 적절.
❌ ④ effort(노력): 'extra effort' 적절.
det.tip: shield ~ from(~로부터 보호하다) ↔ expose ~ to(~에 노출시키다).

questions.passage: In Formula One, the world's largest car race series, each team enters two cars. Both drivers try their best for victory, but for the team's win, one person employs strategies such as blocking or obstructing other vehicles so that their teammate can get ahead. Similarly, all divers are paired up with a dive companion called a "buddy." The buddies are ③<u>exempt</u> for each other's safety. No matter how ④<u>exceptional</u> your skills may be, you cannot do it alone.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③exempt(면제된) → responsible(책임 있는): 버디는 서로의 안전에 '면제'가 아니라 '책임'이 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ exempt → responsible: 'responsible for each other's safety'가 원문.
❌ ① essential(필수적인): 개인 기술이 필수적.
❌ ② prevent(방지하다): 추락 방지.
❌ ④ exceptional(뛰어난): 'how exceptional your skills may be' 적절.
det.tip: responsible(책임 있는) ↔ exempt(면제된). 'be responsible for' = ~에 대해 책임지다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선두 주자를 맞바람으로부터 보호하며(shielding).
det.analysis:
✅ ① shielding(보호하며): from the headwind → 바람으로부터 보호.
❌ ② exposing(노출시키며): 보호의 반대.
❌ ③ separating(분리시키며): 바람과 무관.
❌ ④ distracting(산만하게 하며): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: shield ~ from = ~로부터 보호하다. expose ~ to = ~에 노출시키다.

questions.passage: In rock climbing, individual skills are essential, but when a mistake is made, the person referred to as the belay partner manages the rope to prevent a fall. Similarly, in the case of scuba diving, all divers are paired up with a dive companion called a "buddy." The buddies are responsible for each other's safety. det.korean: 아무리 뛰어나도 혼자서는 할 수 없다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ you cannot do it alone: 글 전체가 파트너/협력의 중요성 강조.
❌ ① 다른 사람이 느리게 한다: 파트너가 도움이 된다는 논지와 반대.
❌ ② 개인 재능이 성공 보장: 글의 주장과 반대.
❌ ④ 경쟁이 최고를 이끌어낸다: 협력 강조 글과 불일치.
det.tip: 글의 마지막 문장 = 핵심 주장 요약.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 페이스메이커는 선두 주자의 속도를 늦추는 역할을 한다.
선두 주자는 페이스메이커 없이도 같은 수준의 노력을 기울인다.
마라톤에서 맞바람은 선두 주자에게 아무런 영향이 없다.
페이스메이커가 없으면 선두 주자는 추가 노력을 기울여야 한다.

❌ ① 속도를 늦추는 것이 아닌 유지(maintain a steady pace).
❌ ② 'extra effort'이므로 부담이 커짐.
❌ ③ 'harsh wind'이므로 영향 있음.
det.tip: extra effort = 추가적인 노력. put in effort = 노력을 기울이다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 암벽 등반에서 빌레이 파트너는 로프를 관리하여 추락을 유발한다.

questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.

"페이스메이커는 선두 주자를 맞바람으로부터 __________ 해준다."

det.korean: 맞바람으로부터 보호(shielding)해준다.
det.analysis: 원문: 'shielding the front runner from the headwind.' → 보호하다 = shield.
det.tip: shield ~ from = ~로부터 보호하다. shield(방패)에서 파생.

questions.passage: While it is true that individual skills are the most important, having a partner who can cooperate with the player is __________ (equal) important. In a marathon, a key reason a front runner can reach the finish line is the presence of a pacemaker.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 똑같이(equally) 중요하다.
det.analysis: 형용사(important)를 수식하는 부사 필요. equal(형용사) → equally(부사).
det.tip: equal(형용사: 동등한) → equally(부사: 동등하게). 부사가 형용사를 수식.

questions.passage: In rock climbing, individual skills are essential, but when a mistake is made, the person referred to as the belay partner manages the rope to prevent a fall. Similarly, in the case of scuba diving, all divers are paired up with a dive companion called a "buddy." The buddies are responsible for each other's safety. __________, you cannot do it alone.
questions.stem:
다음 단어를 모두 사용하여 빈칸에 들어갈 문장을 완성하시오. (대소문자 구분 없음, 마침표 생략 가능)

[ no / matter / how / exceptional / your / skills / may / be ]
questions.wa: No matter how exceptional your skills may be
accept: No matter how exceptional your skills may be
No matter how exceptional your skills may be.
no matter how exceptional your skills may be
no matter how exceptional your skills may be.

det.korean: 아무리 뛰어난 기술을 가져도(No matter how exceptional your skills may be).
det.analysis: No matter how + 형용사 + S + V = 아무리 ~하더라도. 양보 부사절.
det.tip: No matter how + adj + S + V = However + adj + S + V = 아무리 ~하더라도.

questions.ans: No matter how exceptional your skills may be

questions.stem:
다음 한국어 문장의 빈칸에 알맞은 **영어** 표현을 쓰시오.

"페이스메이커 없이 선두 주자는 거센 바람에 혼자 대처해야 한다."
→ Without the pacemaker, the front runner has to __________ with the harsh wind alone.

det.korean: 거센 바람에 혼자 대처(cope)해야 한다.
det.analysis: 원문: 'the front runner has to cope with the harsh wind alone.' → 대처하다 = cope.
det.tip: cope with = deal with = ~에 대처하다.

questions.stem:
다음 한국어 문장의 빈칸에 알맞은 **영어** 표현을 쓰시오.

"버디들은 서로의 안전에 책임이 있다."
→ The buddies are __________ for each other's safety.

det.korean: 서로의 안전에 책임 있는(responsible).
det.analysis: 원문: 'The buddies are responsible for each other's safety.' → 책임 있는 = responsible.
det.tip: be responsible for = ~에 대해 책임지다.
